title: The console's top bar no longer lets scrolled content show through it
detail: Owner screenshot 2026-10-20 (the Space Spotlight editor): the sticky top bar let the page's text read through behind the breadcrumb and nav. The kit paints .ad-top at 82% of --fq-surface-card with a blur; admin-shell.css (hand-kept, tokens only) now raises the fill to 96%, keeping the glass edge. Reviewed from the CSS only, not rendered: the console needs a signed-in session, so Daniel's own look at the Spotlight editor is the check.

verify.cmd: node -e "const s=require('fs').readFileSync('app/themes/frequency/admin-shell.css','utf8');if(!/\\.ad-top\\{background:color-mix\\(in oklab,var\\(--fq-surface-card\\) 9[0-9]%/.test(s)){console.error('LIVE-1068: the console top bar fill is not raised');process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when the console top bar goes back to a fill that shows the page through it.
